name: Large world
description: A large procedural world without physics: a generated 200 m terrain, 1,500 trees, 2,000 bushes and 300 rocks in instanced LOD pools (down to cross-quads and an octahedral impostor) in a spatial domain, static props, lanterns with light culling, and a bobbing crate stack a second camera follows (C switches to it). The day-night sky box's lights take over from the scene's sun and ambient.
